suitableFor: highlighted quotations set apart from body prose
quotations with an optional attribution/citation line
notSuitableFor: inline blockquotes that should stay part of default body content
testimonials with author photos (use cards or a testimonial block)
callouts requiring background color or icons

distinctFrom.quote: Built from the Block Collection vanilla 'quote' block. quote-pull is styled as a spacious, centered pull-quote (max 900px, 120% quotation size, decorative smart-quote glyphs) for magazine article bodies. No existing quote variant in the project, so a new variant was created.
